disclaimer: This is general safety guidance, not professional or official advice. GigSaathi cannot call anyone or share your location. In an emergency, call the numbers below from your phone.

emergency.title: In an emergency, call from your phone

sections.title: Night shifts and personal safety
tips: Tell someone you trust where you are working tonight, and share your live location with them from your phone's own map or chat app.
Choose well-lit main roads over shortcuts. Avoid stopping in empty or dark places.
If a pickup or drop point feels unsafe, ask the customer or restaurant to meet you somewhere public and busy.
Keep your phone charged and carry a power bank.
Trust your instinct. If a situation feels wrong, leave, then report it to the platform afterwards.

sections.title: Road safety for delivery partners and drivers
tips: Always wear a good-quality helmet (if you ride) or a seat belt (if you drive).
Do not use the phone while moving. Stop safely to check an order.
Never speed to save a few minutes. A late order is better than an accident.
Check brakes, tyres and lights regularly, and use reflective strips or lights at night.
Slow down in rain and on wet or oily roads.

sections.title: Be ready for an emergency
tips: Save family contacts and the emergency numbers above on your phone.
Put your name, a family contact and blood group on your phone's emergency info screen if it has one.
Keep your licence, vehicle papers and insurance papers safe, with photos stored on your phone.
Know where the nearest hospital or police station is on your usual routes.
Keep a small first-aid kit with you.

sections.title: Handling difficult work situations
tips: If a customer is rude or threatening, stay calm, do not argue, and leave if you feel unsafe.
Keep screenshots of orders, messages and payments. They help if you later need to complain.
Never share your OTP, bank PIN or password with anyone, including people who say they are from the platform.
Report harassment or threats to the platform. For danger, call 112; women can also call 1091.
Take regular breaks. Tiredness is a major cause of accidents.
